rha-v0.1.1.description:
Fixes
# Info
* [Info](https://thelx5.github.io/rha/info.html)
* [Setup](https://thelx5.github.io/rha/setup.html)
# Changes
* Now compiled with the PLUS version changes. Didn't vibe so much with the localized SFXs so that's gonna be for a future version whenever I feel less lazy
* Added some padding to IDs so ID 0 is no longer used for Karate Man
* Perfect clears are now sent properly
* Collect support for OK and Superb
* Perfect campaigns have "1 level" of delay between campaigns
rha-v0.1.1.title: Rhythm Heaven Advance v0.1.1

rha-v1.0.0.description:
Patch selector, also individual level unlocks. Feels feature complete to me.
# Info
* [Info](https://thelx5.github.io/rha/index.html)
* [Setup](https://thelx5.github.io/rha/setup.html)
# Changes
* Players can now select which extra changes related to localization and QoL they'd like to see when playing
* It's now possible to unlock levels individually
* Added a small label that tells players which item they've received
* Medals are updated automatically on the main menu
* Added location groups for Clears, OK Clears, Superb Clears and Perfect Clears
## Notes
* You need to reload the game menu to see any changes on the level grid, especially on the first load.
rha-v1.0.0.title: Rhythm Heaven Advance v1.0.0
